claims.claim_ar: أداة الاستثناء «إِلَّا» في بداية الآية تعمل حصرًا/قصرًا، فتُقيّد المعنى العام وتُظهر خصوصية المقصود (أي: الاستثناء لمن رحمهم ربُّك).
claims.claim_en: The exception particle 'إِلَّا' functions as hasr/qasr (restriction/exclusion), limiting the general statement and highlighting the specific exception (those whom your Lord has mercy on).
claims.rhetorical_effect: Narrows the scope of a general assertion, producing emphasis on the excluded group and clarifying that the stated consequence does not apply to them.
